45–90 min (mostly the walk through the jungle)

A pirate forgot his treasure in a cave behind a waterfall, near the lair of the treacherous {creature:Hydra|Hydras}, in Tiquanda. Cross the jungle to the hidden hole near {npc:The Blind Prophet}, climb through the cave, jump off the waterfall and open the chest to receive the {item:Pirate Backpack}, the {item:Pirate Hat} and the {item:Dwarven Ring}.

empty, it is on the beach next to the chest (optional)
The way there is the most dangerous part: the Tiquanda jungle is full of creatures. Bring potions and antidotes.

If you are not in **Port Hope** yet, take a boat there (for example with {npc:Captain Bluebear} at Thais harbour): say {key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes}. You arrive at the city harbour, next to {npc:Charles}.

There are two routes to the hidden hole near {npc:The Blind Prophet}:
- Via the **west**, from **Port Hope**, passing through the area south of {wiki:Banuta}: you meet {creature:Bug|Bugs}, {creature:Snake|Snakes}, {creature:Centipede|Centipedes}, {creature:Carniphila|Carniphilas}, {creature:Wasp|Wasps}, {creature:Bat|Bats}, {creature:Tiger|Tigers}, {creature:Slime|Slimes}, {creature:Skunk|Skunks}, {creature:Crocodile|Crocodiles}, {creature:Kongra|Kongras}, {creature:Sibang|Sibangs}, {creature:Terror Bird|Terror Birds}, {creature:Scorpion|Scorpions}, {creature:Tarantula|Tarantulas}, {creature:Spit Nettle|Spit Nettles} and maybe the rare {creature:Tiquandas Revenge}.
- Via the **south**, from {wiki:Kha'Zeel}, through the {creature:Elephant|Elephants} area next to the Hydra spawn: you meet Snakes, Bugs, Slimes, Crocodiles, Scorpions, Tarantulas, Elephants, {creature:Dwarf|Dwarfs}, {creature:Dwarf Soldier|Dwarf Soldiers} and {creature:Dwarf Guard|Dwarf Guards}.
If you come from the south, beware of {creature:Hydra|Hydras} drawn in by other players!
There is now a log across the river, which makes the route a little easier (but no less dangerous) than crossing the northern Tiquanda jungle.
Go down the hidden hole near {npc:The Blind Prophet}, in the northeast of Tiquanda, south of the {wiki:Forbidden Lands|Forbidden Lands}.
Follow the cave **west** and climb up the several holes with the {item:Rope}.
Go **south** along the cliff wall to the **east**: stand where the character is in the image and walk to the right.
Stand where the character is and walk to the right
Throw yourself off the waterfall (it is the yellow "stairs" spot on the minimap). Then swim **1 sqm north** and you are teleported behind the waterfall wall.
After you fall from the waterfall you can only move **north** to enter the cave.

Inside the cave, swim **south**, come out onto the beach and open the chest to receive the rewards. To the left of the beach there is a {item:Rum Flask} that you can also take (it is empty, with no {item:Rum}).
Go back **north** to the teleport to leave the cave. Do not try to go back through the waterfall: after you fall you can only move north.

Outside, return through the jungle by the **same way you came**: cross the river by the log and head **west**, south of {wiki:Banuta}, to **Port Hope** (or go back south, towards {wiki:Kha'Zeel}, if you came that way). You will meet the same creatures as on the way in. In Port Hope, {npc:Charles} takes you by boat to other cities.
